seo.title: Best Natural Wine Bars in Bali (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Bali's top natural wine bars and restaurants. From Canggu's trendy spots to Ubud's hidden gems, find the best biodynamic and organic wines for every taste and budget.

hero.h1: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Bali
hero.subtitle: Bali's burgeoning natural wine scene offers a delightful journey from volcanic vineyards to sun-drenched beaches, featuring biodynamic sips and organic pours in stylish settings across Canggu, Ubud, and Seminyak.

picks.name: PNNT (Pants)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: PNNT, affectionately known as Pants, is a pioneer in Bali's natural wine scene. This cozy yet stylish bar boasts an ever-evolving list of biodynamic and organic wines from around the globe, complemented by a concise menu of delectable small plates. It's the perfect spot for both seasoned natural wine aficionados and curious newcomers to explore unique expressions of the grape.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask the knowledgeable staff for a recommendation from their rotating list of orange wines or a rare pet-nat.
picks.insiderTip: Arrive early on weekends to snag a coveted spot, as it gets wonderfully lively and intimate as the evening progresses.
picks.redditQuote: "PNNT in Canggu is seriously legit for natural wine. Their selection is insane, and the vibe is just perfect for chilling after a surf. Total hidden gem for actual wine lovers."

picks.name: Botol Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled in the spiritual heart of Ubud, Botol Bar offers a serene escape with an impressive focus on natural, organic, and biodynamic wines. Its tranquil setting, often featuring live ambient music, pairs beautifully with a thoughtful menu of Asian-inspired tapas, creating a holistic dining and drinking experience that’s unique to Ubud.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of volcanic-soil wine paired with their crispy pork belly skewers.
picks.insiderTip: Check their social media for special tasting events or guest winemaker appearances, which offer a deeper dive into the natural wine world.
picks.redditQuote: "Botol Bar in Ubud is my new favorite. The natural wine selection is incredible, and the atmosphere is so chilled out and perfect for a date. Definitely worth the scooter ride up!"

picks.name: Bar Souvenir
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A charming and unpretentious gem in Pererenan, Bar Souvenir brings a slice of Parisian natural wine bar culture to Bali. With a concise but expertly curated list of European natural wines, this spot is perfect for a casual evening of good wine, simple yet delicious French-inspired snacks, and genuine conversation. It embodies a 'less is more' philosophy.
picks.whatToOrder: A chilled glass of Beaujolais-Villages Nature with their classic sourdough and butter or a cheese platter.
picks.insiderTip: This spot is tiny and fills up fast; consider going on a weekday evening for a more relaxed experience.
picks.redditQuote: "Bar Souvenir in Pererenan is exactly what I needed. No fuss, just really good natural wine and super chill vibes. Great prices for Bali too."

picks.name: The Slow
picks.whyItMadeTheList: More than just a restaurant, The Slow is an immersive experience blending art, design, and culinary excellence within a boutique hotel. Their sophisticated dining room and bar offer a meticulously curated wine list, featuring a strong emphasis on natural, organic, and small-batch labels, perfectly complementing their artfully presented, ingredient-driven menu.
picks.whatToOrder: Pair a glass from their 'living wine' selection with their grilled octopus or a seasonal vegetable dish.
picks.insiderTip: Explore the hotel's art gallery before or after your meal for a complete cultural immersion.
picks.redditQuote: "The Slow has such a cool, understated vibe. Their wine list had some fantastic natural options I hadn't seen elsewhere in Bali, and the food was amazing. Definitely splurge-worthy."

picks.name: Santanera
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Santanera is a culinary journey fusing Mediterranean and South American influences with a strong commitment to quality ingredients and an exceptional beverage program. Their extensive wine cellar includes a dedicated section for natural and biodynamic wines, expertly paired with their vibrant, flavour-packed dishes in a chic, multi-level setting that offers stunning views.
picks.whatToOrder: Consult with the sommelier for a natural wine pairing that elevates their Wagyu picanha or seafood paella.
picks.insiderTip: Book a table on the rooftop for sunset drinks and breathtaking views before heading down for dinner.
picks.redditQuote: "Santanera's wine list is next level, especially if you're into natural wines. The food is equally impressive, making it a top contender for a fancy night out in Canggu."

picks.name: Mason
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Known for its industrial-chic aesthetic and exceptional charcoal-grilled fare, Mason also holds a strong reputation for its thoughtful beverage program. While famous for cocktails, their wine list is carefully curated, featuring a selection of natural, organic, and interesting small-producer wines that beautifully complement their smoky, flavourful dishes.
picks.whatToOrder: A robust natural red wine to stand up to their signature Wagyu short rib or grilled halloumi.
picks.insiderTip: Don't miss the opportunity to visit The Back Room, Mason's speakeasy-style bar located behind the restaurant, for a different cocktail experience.
picks.redditQuote: "Mason's food is a must-try, but their wine list really surprised me with some great natural options. It's a solid choice if you want amazing food AND good wine in Canggu."

picks.name: Skool Kitchen
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched above the waves of Echo Beach, Skool Kitchen is an elemental dining experience where everything touches the flame. Their innovative menu is matched by an equally inventive wine list, which meticulously sources natural, low-intervention, and classic wines that can stand up to the bold flavors of their fire-kissed dishes. It’s a sophisticated spot for a sunset meal.
picks.whatToOrder: An earthy natural white or a light red to pair with their whole grilled fish or wood-fired vegetables.
picks.insiderTip: Aim for a table just before sunset to witness a spectacular Balinese sky while enjoying your meal and wine.
picks.redditQuote: "Skool Kitchen is unreal. The food cooked over fire is insane, and I was stoked they had a really solid natural wine selection to go with it. Pricey, but worth it for the view and quality."

picks.name: Cantina
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Cantina brings authentic Italian flavors and rustic charm to Canggu, complete with a robust wine program that features a thoughtful selection of natural and biodynamic Italian wines. It's a vibrant, bustling spot perfect for sharing pizzas, handmade pastas, and a bottle of expertly chosen, low-intervention vino with friends and family.
picks.whatToOrder: A natural Sangiovese to complement their truffle pasta or a crisp Vermentino with a classic Margherita pizza.
picks.insiderTip: Their aperitivo hour often features special wine deals – a great way to try different natural wines without breaking the bank.
picks.redditQuote: "Cantina in Canggu has such great vibes and their natural wine list is surprisingly good for an Italian place. Loved pairing a skin-contact white with their seafood pasta."

picks.name: Shelter Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Shelter Restaurant in Pererenan is a serene oasis known for its focus on healthy, modern Australian cuisine and a welcoming, earthy ambiance. Beyond their delectable brunch and dinner menus, they offer a discerning selection of wines, often including organic and natural labels that align with their ethos of wholesome, quality ingredients. It's a great spot for a relaxed meal.
picks.whatToOrder: A light, refreshing natural white wine to go with their signature nourish bowl or grilled barramundi.
picks.insiderTip: While popular for brunch, Shelter transforms into a beautifully atmospheric dinner spot, perfect for a quiet evening with good wine.
picks.redditQuote: "Shelter in Pererenan is a solid choice. Great food, and they actually have a few decent natural wines on the list. Good place for a chill meal."

picks.name: Indigo Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Indigo Restaurant offers an exquisite journey into contemporary Japanese cuisine, with a strong emphasis on fresh, high-quality ingredients and artful presentation. Their sophisticated beverage program includes a selection of premium sakes and a thoughtfully curated wine list that features several natural and organic labels, chosen to perfectly complement the delicate flavors of their sushi and sashimi.
picks.whatToOrder: A crisp, mineral-driven natural white wine or a delicate natural rosé to pair with their chef's selection sashimi.
picks.insiderTip: Opt for a seat at the sushi counter to watch the skilled chefs at work while enjoying your meal and wine.
picks.redditQuote: "Indigo is top-tier Japanese in Canggu. I was pleasantly surprised to find some excellent natural wines on their menu that paired so well with the sushi. A bit pricey but worth it."

picks.name: Fishbone Local
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Fishbone Local is Canggu's go-to spot for sustainable seafood served in a laid-back, industrial-chic setting. With a commitment to fresh, locally sourced ingredients, their menu is a celebration of the ocean. Their wine list, while concise, often features natural and organic white wines and light reds that are perfect companions to their grilled fish, ceviches, and fresh oysters.
picks.whatToOrder: A refreshing natural Sauvignon Blanc or a light skin-contact white to pair with the fish tacos or grilled snapper.
picks.insiderTip: They often have daily specials showcasing the freshest catch – ask the staff for their recommendations.
picks.redditQuote: "If you love seafood and want something decent to drink, Fishbone Local is great. They had a really nice natural white wine that went perfectly with the fresh fish. Super casual and tasty."

picks.name: Vin+ Retail & Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Vin+ is a unique concept that combines an extensive wine retail store with a stylish restaurant and bar. While offering a vast selection of wines from around the world, they also stock a growing number of natural, organic, and biodynamic labels available for both purchase and enjoyment on-site. It's an excellent destination for exploring new wines and pairing them with a diverse international menu.
picks.whatToOrder: Browse their retail shelves for a unique natural wine, then enjoy it in the restaurant with their truffle fries or a pasta dish.
picks.insiderTip: Take advantage of their 'corkage free' policy when buying a bottle from the retail section to enjoy with your meal at the restaurant.
picks.redditQuote: "Vin+ is a good shout if you're serious about wine. They have so many bottles, including a decent natural selection. You can pick one from the shop and drink it there, which is awesome."

faq.question: What exactly is natural wine?
faq.answer: Natural wine is made with minimal intervention, typically from organically or biodynamically farmed grapes. It involves spontaneous fermentation using native yeasts, no added sulfites (or very minimal), and no fining or filtration, aiming for a pure expression of the grape and terroir.

faq.question: Is natural wine expensive in Bali?
faq.answer: Prices for natural wine in Bali can vary widely. While some entry-level natural wines by the glass might be comparable to conventional wines (IDR 100,000-150,000 / $7-10), unique or imported bottles can be significantly more expensive (IDR 800,000+ / $55+), reflecting their artisanal production and import costs.

faq.question: Are there any local Balinese natural wines?
faq.answer: While Bali has local wines (like Hatten Wines), truly 'natural' or 'biodynamic' winemaking is still a very nascent concept in Indonesia, primarily due to climate and regulatory challenges. Most natural wines found in Bali bars are imported from traditional wine-producing regions like Europe or Australia.

faq.question: How do I choose a good natural wine if I'm new to it?
faq.answer: Don't be afraid to ask the staff for recommendations! Many natural wines have unique profiles (e.g., 'funky' or 'cloudy' for orange wines). Describe your usual wine preferences or what you're eating, and let the sommelier guide you to something you might enjoy. Tasting flights are also a great way to explore.

faq.question: Do natural wine bars in Bali offer food?
faq.answer: Yes, almost all natural wine bars and restaurants featuring natural wine lists in Bali offer food. This ranges from small plates and tapas designed to complement the wine, to full-service dining menus with diverse culinary offerings, ensuring a complete experience.

faq.question: What's the best area in Bali for natural wine bars?
faq.answer: Canggu is arguably the epicenter for Bali's natural wine scene, with several dedicated bars and restaurants offering excellent selections. Ubud is also emerging with a few notable spots, while Seminyak tends to have broader wine selections that may include natural options.

methodology: Our selections for Bali's best natural wine bars are based on extensive research, local recommendations, and expert reviews, focusing on establishments with dedicated natural wine lists, knowledgeable staff, and a commitment to sustainable practices. We evaluated venues on wine selection, atmosphere, food pairing options, and overall value to bring you a diverse and authentic guide.
